calculation_steps: For lower sigma and upper eta, A_sigma,eta=B_sigma,eta, A_eta,sigma=-B_sigma,eta; with D lower=-1 upper=+1, j=-2B c_sigma c_eta yields rho prime=Dj.
For c0=v0+2e01, B_v0,e01=-1, j_v0->e01=4, so S_v0 prime=-4 and edge01 prime=+4; HOLD derivatives zero.
Taylor c=x+sAx+s²A²x/2 gives S_v0=1-4s+s²+O(s³); leakage stocks v1=4s²,e02=e03=s²,f012=f013=4s²+O(s³).
All 15 constant, linear and quadratic stock coefficients sum to (5,0,0); A³=-4A yields exact c_v0=1-sin(2s)-3(1-cos(2s))/4.

result.scope: fixed filled K4 Q169/Q170 convention, predeclared preparation/cut, external stationary HOLD baseline
